cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey's egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

cards.name: Castform
cards.description: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Komala
cards.description: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.description: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.description: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.description: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.description: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.description: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.description: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.description: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Alolan Golem
cards.description: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.description: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.description: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.description: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Minior
cards.description: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.description: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.description: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.description: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.description: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
